title: Consensus Player — Accessibility Fix Backlog (af5f0eba6)
sources: Cursor: live axe-core + Playwright audit (identity, opt-in, topic rating) with independent contrast + hit-target measurement

items.title: Entire demo renders in a grey theme — 14/18 Page A styles fail (78%)
items.detail: Systematic Claude pass: 14 of 18 checked text styles fail on Page A alone (78%), all tracing to rgb(169,169,169) — white-on-grey 2.35:1 and grey-on-#F0F0F0 2.06:1. Page C is better but still 6/20 fail. Cursor independently sampled the same tokens (2.06:1 / 2.35:1). Broken theme appears scoped to components, not one global variable; other demos use vivid brand orange.
items.fix: Investigate the missing/failed brand theme assignment for this demo, and add a contrast-safe token fallback so a themeless demo cannot ship below 4.5:1 (3:1 for UI boundaries).
items.verified: Claude systematic style enumeration + Cursor computed-style measurement

items.title: Topic-rating checkboxes render at 0×0 and are unreachable by keyboard
items.detail: Cursor confirmed all 6 rating inputs (2 topics × 3 ratings) return width 0 / height 0 from getBoundingClientRect() with tabIndex 0 and no accessible name. Chrome's sequential focus skips zero-dimension elements regardless of tabIndex, so keyboard-only users cannot rate topics — and rating is required to continue. Third demo where this reproduces.
items.fix: Give the input real dimensions matching the visible star/check/X icon (or move focus to a sized sibling), then add aria-labels. Fix once at the shared component.
items.verified: Independently confirmed by Cursor getBoundingClientRect() probe

items.title: Rating controls are checkboxes implementing mutually-exclusive radio behavior
items.detail: Cursor observed the 6 inputs share one name per topic (da4cbc5f… and b26ca434…), i.e. radio-group semantics implemented with type=checkbox and no role=radiogroup/radio.
items.fix: Convert to role=radiogroup + role=radio (or native radios) with per-option labels, alongside the hit-target fix.
items.verified: Independently confirmed by Cursor DOM probe (shared name attribute)

items.title: Product tour close (X) button does not respond to clicks
items.detail: Claude observed two click attempts failing to dismiss the tour overlay, stranding the visitor. Not reproducible by Cursor this pass — tour sits behind the rating gate and inside a cross-origin iframe.
items.fix: Check click handler / hit-target registration and z-index or event propagation on the tour close control.

items.title: Opt-In toggle is 0×0 and has no accessible name
items.detail: Cursor probe found input[data-testid="optin toggle"] at width 0 / height 0 with empty accessible name; axe also reports it under the label rule on all identity states.
items.fix: Give the toggle real dimensions and associate the visible “Opt In” text via label for/id or aria-labelledby.

items.title: Modal close (X) has no accessible name
items.detail: Shared modal-header close component, flagged by axe button-name on the Opt-In modal. Same component as the other two demos.
items.fix: Add aria-label="Close" at the shared modal-header component.
items.verified: Confirmed by Cursor axe on this demo

items.title: Opt-In modal has no dialog accessible name; spinner progressbar unnamed
items.detail: axe reports aria-dialog-name and aria-progressbar-name on the Opt-In modal, matching the be2376b21 result.
items.fix: Add aria-labelledby on a real heading for the dialog; label or hide the button spinner from assistive tech.
items.verified: Confirmed by Cursor axe on this demo

items.title: Corrupted / duplicated legal disclaimer copy — third confirmation
items.detail: The garbled “…gitimate Interesgitimate Interes…” string renders on this demo's identity screen too, and is read in full by screen readers. Also contributes to the contrast failures on the footer text.
items.fix: Fix the template / string-concatenation logic at the source, then apply the corrected copy.
items.verified: Confirmed by Cursor page text capture

items.title: Tab key advances the tour instead of moving focus
items.detail: Claude observed Tab moving the tour spotlight rather than performing conventional focus navigation, which breaks keyboard expectations and blocks tabbing the underlying page.
items.fix: Decide deliberately: keep Tab as focus navigation with dedicated Next/Back controls, or signal the repurposed behavior visibly each step.
items.verified: Claude-only — tour not reachable by Cursor this pass

items.title: Tour content is a cross-origin iframe and cannot be audited from the parent
items.detail: Only the iframe title ("Dynamic tour") is verifiable externally. The tour's internal DOM/ARIA needs a pass from inside the ReachSuite / tour-builder codebase.
items.fix: Schedule a dedicated audit inside the tour codebase, or provide tooling that can reach into the iframe.

items.title: Missing landmarks and content outside regions
items.detail: axe reports landmark-one-main plus region violations across identity, opt-in and topic rating; duplicate contentinfo and landmark-unique on the opt-in state.
items.fix: Add a single <main>, unique labelled landmarks, and wrap page content in regions.

items.title: Heading order jumps (h5 with no preceding levels)
items.detail: axe heading-order on the Opt-In modal — the “Opt In” heading is an h5 with no higher-level headings.
items.fix: Use a real heading hierarchy once Design confirms structure.

items.title: Three “Select all” buttons share one accessible name
items.detail: Very / Somewhat / Not important columns each expose an identical “Select all” name with no column context.
items.verified: Observed by Cursor on this demo

items.title: Document title is the demo's internal name
items.detail: Title reads “Dylan Standard personalized with tours” rather than visitor-appropriate copy.
items.fix: Set a meaningful document.title for viewers.

items.title: Required-field asterisk convention has no programmatic equivalent
items.detail: Carried over from the shared registration form; third confirmation across demos.
items.fix: Add aria-required / required at the shared field component.

items.title: Focus ring exists but both layers fail 3:1 (worse than a754d887d)
items.detail: Same two-layer box-shadow technique as a754d887d, but here both layers fail non-text contrast — inner rgb(198,198,198) = 1.71:1 vs white / 1.50:1 vs light-grey; outer rgb(151,151,151) = 2.92:1 vs white. On a754d887d the outer layer alone passed at 3.61:1 because brand orange kept saturation. Ring is present on Contact me / I'm new here / identity buttons but not reliably visible. Opt-In toggle still has zero focus indicator via all three mechanisms.
items.fix: Darken the focus-ring token so both layers meet ≥3:1 on this (and themeless) demos; ensure Opt-In gets the same token. Root cause is the desaturated grey theme — fixing theme assignment also improves ring contrast.

items.title: Duplicate “Test User” tab stop on identity screen
items.detail: Real Tab sequence hits “Test User” twice consecutively — likely a stale/duplicated focusable element from session/identity state.
items.fix: Remove the duplicate focusable node from the identity picker DOM.

items.title: “Now Playing” tab label at 4.15:1 — independent of grey theme
items.detail: Dark navy on near-transparent grey measures 4.15:1 (needs 4.5:1). Close miss and not caused by the rgb(169,169,169) placeholder — separate small-margin contrast issue.
items.fix: Slightly darken the tab label or raise its background opacity to clear 4.5:1.
